name: Vocabulary topics
_howto: Each topic is one block inside topics[]. Words are written as: word | clue. Put * before a harder (B2) word. Minimum 4 words per topic.

topics.name: Jobs
words: nurse | a person who looks after sick people in a hospital
plumber | a person who repairs water pipes
lawyer | a person who gives legal advice in court
electrician | a person who fits and repairs electric wires
firefighter | a person who puts out fires
architect | a person who designs buildings
*accountant | a person who keeps financial records
*surgeon | a doctor who operates on patients

topics.name: Technology
words: screen | the flat part of a phone or computer where you see things
keyboard | the set of keys you use to type
download | to copy a file from the internet to your device
password | a secret word that lets you enter an account
charger | you use it to put energy into a phone battery
*software | the programs that run on a computer
*cybersecurity | protection of computers from online attacks
*algorithm | a set of steps a computer follows to solve a problem

topics.name: Weather
words: cloudy | with a lot of clouds in the sky
foggy | with thick white air close to the ground, so you can't see far
windy | with a lot of wind
thunderstorm | heavy rain with loud noises and lightning
freezing | extremely cold
*drought | a long period with no rain
*heatwave | a period of very hot weather

topics.name: Travel
words: airline | an organization that provides regular flights for passengers or cargo (línea aérea)
board | to get on a ship, aircraft, train, or bus (subir a bordo (de), embarcarse (en))
check in | to register upon arrival at an airport or hotel (facturar (aeropuerto))
crew | a group of people who work together, especially operating an aircraft or ship (tripulación)
delay | to cause something to happen at a later time than planned (retrasar)
fabulous | extraordinarily good, wonderful, or impressive (fabuloso/a, increíble)
flight attendant | a person whose job is to look after passengers on an aircraft (auxiliar de vuelo / cabina)
full board | a hotel arrangement that includes accommodation and all daily meals (pensión completa)
gate | the area in an airport where passengers wait to board their flight (puerta (de embarque))
half board | a hotel arrangement that includes accommodation, breakfast, and one main meal (media pensión)
high season | the period of the year when travel and tourism are at their peak (temporada alta)
in advance | ahead of time or before a specific event occurs (con antelación)
lively | full of life, energy, and activity (animado/a, bullicioso/a; alegre)
luxurious | extremely comfortable, elegant, and expensive (lujoso/a)
on a budget | with a limited amount of money to spend (con un presupuesto ajustado, sin mucho dinero)
overcrowded | containing too many people or things (atestado/a de gente)
rate | a fixed price or charge for a service or accommodation (tarifa, precio)
unforgettable | impossible to forget; memorable (inolvidable)
within walking distance | close enough to reach easily by walking (que se puede ir andando)
accommodation | a room or building in which someone may live or stay (alojamiento)
youth hostel | an inexpensive lodging facility geared toward young travelers (albergue juvenil)
*platform | the area next to railway tracks where passengers get on or off trains (andén)
*return ticket | a ticket that allows travel to a destination and back again (billete de ida y vuelta)
*single ticket | a ticket valid for a journey to a destination without returning (billete de ida)
*souvenir | something kept as a reminder of a place visited (recuerdo, souvenir)
